scenes.title: Cold Static in C-17
scenes.narration:
The rain in District C-17 does not wash the city clean; it only smears the neon grease across the cracked asphalt. You wake with your cheek pressed against cold, wet concrete, the bitter taste of copper and burnt silicon lingering on your tongue. Your limbs feel strangely light, almost hollow, as if your physical form is struggling to keep pace with your unregistered ghost signal. A phantom ache pulses in your temple—a sensory echo of a past loop, of a blade of light cutting through a dark sky, though the memory slips away like oil on water the harder you try to grasp it. You are entirely alone in this narrow, garbage-choked alleyway, wrapped in a silence so absolute it feels artificial.

Suddenly, a dead public welfare terminal at the far end of the alley hums to life. Its cracked screen flickers with a violent, violet glare, casting long, jittery shadows against the brick walls. A burst of raw static cuts through the sound of the falling rain, followed by a heavily scrambled, genderless voice leaking from the rusted speaker grill. '. . . if you are receiving this. . . do not let them optimize your memory. . . the scrapyard at Grid 09-Beta still holds the raw code. . . remember. . . ' The voice cuts out with a sharp pop, leaving only a string of glowing green coordinates smeared behind the rainwater running down the glass.
choices: Commit the coordinate fragment to memory (Observation)
Scan the terminal's residual logs for the signal's origin (Intellect)
Ignore the signal as a potential system trap and slip back into the shadows

scenes.title: Shadows of the C-17 Blackout Alley
scenes.narration: The neon pulse from the high-altitude advertising boards casts long, twitching shadows across the wet bricks. You pull your collar up, retreating into the pitch-black gap between two rusted power generators. Above you, a low hum vibrates through the metal siding as a patrol drone sweeps its blue searchlight across the main street, just inches from your hiding spot. Your 'unregistered signal' signature remains quiet, wrapped in the silent step of a ghost. The signal on your wrist stops itching, settling into a cold, dormant numbness.
choices: Slip into the dark, yawning entrance of the abandoned C-17 subway line (Agility)
Examine the flickering welfare kiosk at the corner for local maps (Observation)

scenes.title: The Glitching Archive of C-17
scenes.narration:
A rusted welfare kiosk stands at the mouth of the alley, its cracked screen sputtering with a pale, sickly light that reflects off the pooling rain. The terminal displays a distorted map of the disposal tier, its street names flickering like dying stars. As you approach, the system's vocal feedback speaker crackles, emitting a low, rhythmic hum that sounds almost like a mechanical sigh.

(Observation: The neon sign's spark cycle isn't regular. A vibration that breaks the pattern — an eavesdropping module hidden behind it, detected. The frequency matches the signature of an active patrol grid sweep, but it is currently lagging by three seconds. )

You trace your fingers along the casing, avoiding the exposed wiring. The screen displays a blinking icon at the sub-level coordinates you received earlier, labeled only as 'Unresolved Discard'. Below that, a secondary path through the old storm drains is highlighted in yellow, suggesting a way to bypass the active scanner net entirely.
choices: Descend directly into the mouth of the disposal tier following the coordinates (Agility)
Take the longer, hidden route through the storm drains to avoid detection (Observation)
Force-download the local sector map and clean the access logs (Intellect)

scenes.title: Intercepted Coordinates of the Undergrid
scenes.narration: The welfare kiosk screen screeches as your raw connection forces its way past the security buffer, downloading the raw layout of C-17. Cold rainwater drips from your hair onto the keys as the terminal's cooling fan spins up with a dying rattle, dumping local sector routes directly into your memory. (Intellect: Sector download complete. Access logs scrubbed at 99. 4% efficiency. However, the unexpected power spike has tripped a local relay. We have exactly forty-five seconds before the grid registers this node as a dead zone. ) The screen suddenly turns a deep, bruised purple, displaying an unauthorized data-packet containing coordinates for a nearby scrap yard. A drone engine whines in the distance, its searchlight slicing through the falling rain toward your position. You have to move before they lock onto the signal spike.
choices: Slip down into the open storm drain route to bypass the surface patrol (Agility)
Head directly toward the decrypted scrapyard coordinates through the shadow route

scenes.title: Through the Iron Teeth
scenes.narration: Heavy steel plates of the storm drain clatter under your boots as you slip into the narrow shadow route, avoiding the main boulevard where the drone searchlights sweep the wet asphalt. The smell of burnt copper and wet rust rises from the drainage grates, and the hum of the city's power grid vibrates through the soles of your shoes. Ahead, the path narrows into a graveyard of discarded machinery—towering piles of broken drone chassis and stripped terminal casings that block the light. Suddenly, a low, metallic scraping sound echoes from the darkness of a collapsed warehouse entrance on your left, followed by the faint blue flicker of an active sensor eye.
choices: 숨 고르는 골목(으)로 향한다 — 회복하고 다음 위험에 대비합니다. · 안정 +8
감시 사각(으)로 향한다 — 감시망을 은밀히 파고드는 지름길이지만, 순찰과 마주쳐 매복·교전에 휘말릴 위험이 크다. · 위험 2 · 추적도 +3 ⚠

scenes.title: Slipping the Cordon
scenes.narration: The searchlight of a high-altitude patrol drone cuts through the freezing rain, painting the wet concrete walls in blinding white. You press your back against the rusted iron of a discarded turbine, holding your breath as the beam sweeps just inches from your boots. (Agility: No time to hesitate! The drone is on a three-second sweep cycle. Slip under the low pipe now, before the lens rotates back! ) The smell of ionized ozone is thick here, a warning that the drone's high-voltage grid is fully primed. Down the alley, a heavy security shutter blocks the way to the deeper undergrid, its power indicator pulsing with a faint, rhythmic red light that suggests an active terminal lock.
choices: Slide beneath the low pipe and slip through the gap in the shutter (Agility)
Interface directly with the terminal to force-open the shutter (Intellect)

scenes.title: Aftermath in the Iron Graveyard
scenes.narration: The smoking chassis of the patrol drone you just dismantled sparks violently in the freezing rain, its shattered optical lens flickering with a dying blue light. Your knuckles ache from the impact, and the bitter taste of ionized air and burnt copper hangs thick in your throat. You are alive, but the high-altitude sweepers are already adjusting their search patterns to investigate the sudden loss of their unit's signal. There is no time to savor the victory; the control grid's heat is rising, and the alley is rapidly becoming a trap. Through the static of your receiver, a low, urgent voice cuts through. It is Jung Se-rin, her tone sharp and devoid of formal pleasantries: 'The patrol went dark. They will trace the static discharge within two minutes. Move now, or you will be optimized where you stand. ' Her warning mirrors the cold calculation of the city itself, forcing you to choose your escape route immediately.
choices: Slip quietly into the deep storm drain to shake the pursuit (Agility)
Quickly salvage the sparking drone wreckage for usable components (Observation)

scenes.title: Through the Blind Spot
scenes.narration: The dying blue light of the shattered patrol drone flickers one last time before going completely dark. Your fingers work with practiced, silent precision in the freezing rain, slipping into the cracked chassis to wrench the main battery core free before the internal thermal purge can melt it. (Observation: The copper wiring is still warm, and the sub-processor's housing has a hairline crack. That little frequency chip is still intact, though—pull it out before the rain shorts the contacts. ) You slide the salvaged components into your coat just as a low, ominous hum echoes from the upper clouds. The system is already closing the gap in its net. You need to move before the secondary sweepers trace the dead unit's last ping.
choices: Slip down into the open storm drain to bypass the search grid (Agility)
Use the salvaged chip to mask your signal trail on the local terminal (Intellect)

scenes.title: Subterranean Static
scenes.narration: The damp concrete walls of the undergrid drainage tunnel tremble as a heavy patrol unit rumbles on the street above. Water drips from rusted iron pipes, splashing onto your shoulders, but you remain perfectly still, your [유령 신호] trait keeping you invisible to the active sonar sweeps. Jung Se-rin stands a few paces ahead, her hand resting on the hilt of her vibro-blade, her dark eyes scanning the darkness of the lower transit line. 'The system is already rerouting patrol paths to cover the blind spot we used,' she whispers, her voice sharp and devoid of any formal politeness. 'We have less than three minutes before the local node executes a hard diagnostic sweep. ' The stolen processor chip in your hand hums with a faint, warm vibration, its stolen security certificates our only shield against the approaching digital net.
choices: Inject the stolen certificates to forge a permanent maintenance clearance (Intellect)
Slip deeper into the abandoned drainage pipes before the diagnostic scan begins (Agility)

scenes.title: The Fork in the Sump
scenes.narration:
The terminal screen flickers violently, bathing the narrow concrete tunnel in a sickly amber glow. (Intellect: The target sub-routine's safety threshold is currently operating at 88%. Injecting the forged certificate now will override the local gateway with a 94. 2% success rate, completely masking your signal trail from immediate patrol sweeps. ) Your fingers dance across the cracked plastic keypad, forcing the stolen encryption keys into the node. With a soft click, the heavy security gate at the end of the tunnel swings open, but the mechanical groan echoes loudly through the damp corridor.

Jung Se-rin doesn't look back, but her shoulders tense as she watches the dark waters of the drainage canal swirl below. 'We don't have time to admire your handiwork,' she says, her voice a sharp whisper against the constant drip of condensation. 'The patrol above just changed their sweep pattern. They heard that gate. '

Ahead, the passage splits into two distinct routes. To the left, a steep, rusted ladder leads up toward the neon-drenched alleyways of the C-17 market district where crowds might offer cover. To the right, a dark, half-submerged pipe leads deeper into the maintenance undergrid, silent but freezing. You stand at the junction, the cold wind from the street above mixing with the stench of ozone and old water.

추격 길목(으)로 향한다 — 감시망을 은밀히 파고드는 지름길이지만, 순찰과 마주쳐 매복·교전에 휘말릴 위험이 크다. · 위험 2 · 추적도 +3 ⚠

scenes.title: The Smoldering Threshold
scenes.narration: The air inside the C-17 deep-level incinerator is thick with the scent of melted copper and scorched hair. Below the iron catwalk where you stand, a massive furnace pit glows with a violent, white-hot intensity, consuming discarded memory drives and unregistered citizen IDs alike. A group of seven terrified, un-optimized civilians are huddled inside a rusted holding cage suspendeed directly over the open maw of the furnace. Jung Se-rin stands beside you, her knuckles white on her vibro-blade hilt, staring at the automated crane controls that are slowly beginning to lower the cage into the fire. 'They are erasing them,' she whispers, her voice shaking with rare, raw fury. 'Not just killing them, but wiping every trace they ever breathed. '
choices: Sprint across the shaking catwalk to manually jam the crane gears (Agility)
Interface with the thermal console to spoof the incinerator's heat sensor (Intellect)

scenes.title: The Heat Sensor Spoof
scenes.narration: The thermal console hums with a low, bone-rattling vibration, radiating heat that makes the sweat on your collar instantly evaporate. (Intellect: The local thermal sensor operates on a dual-channel loop. Injecting a false 300-degree baseline offset will trick the core regulator into thinking the chamber is already cool, halting the automated descent sequence for the holding cage. ) Your fingers fly across the grease-stained mechanical switches, overriding the safety interlocks one by one. Down below, the massive iron cage jolts to a sudden stop, dangling mere feet above the white-hot furnace pit. The seven trapped civilians scream in terror as the sudden halt shakes their rusted cage, but the red warning lights on the console shift to a steady, deceptive green. Above the din, the heavy thrum of an Enforcer unit's patrol boots echoes from the gantry behind you—the control grid has detected the sudden drop in incinerator load and is closing in fast.
choices: Sprint to the manual release lever and swing the cage to the safety platform (Agility)
Draw your weapon and ambush the incoming Enforcer patrol to buy them time

scenes.title: A Stand in the Spark-Rain
scenes.narration: The heavy steel doors of the incinerator hall hiss open, admitting three hulking Enforcer units with red optical sensors cutting through the drifting steam. Behind you, the holding cage containing the terrified civilians sways on its chain, its descent halted but still vulnerable. Jung Se-rin stands by the console, her pistol raised, her eyes reflecting the crimson glare of the furnace. 'We don't let them burn, not this time,' she says, her voice hard and low over the roar of the coolant pipes. You step forward, drawing your sidearm as your silent footsteps find purchase on the slick, wet iron grid of the catwalk. The lead Enforcer raises its heavy rifle, its target-acquisition laser painting a bright red dot directly onto your chest.
choices: Execute an Overload Strike on the lead Enforcer's power core (Agility)
Lay down suppressive fire while Se-rin pulls the emergency release lever (Strength)

scenes.title: Through the Coolant Smoke
scenes.narration: The smoking chassis of the last Enforcer unit sparks violently on the wet concrete floor, its red optical sensor flickering out into darkness. Your lungs burn from the acrid smell of scorched wire and chemical coolant, a direct consequence of the desperate firefight you just survived. Jung Se-rin lowers her pistol, her boots splashing through a shallow pool of hydraulic oil as she rushes toward the suspended holding cage. 'The grid knows we're here now,' she says, her voice tight and unyielding as she reaches for the cage's manual release. 'These people are unregistered signals to ARK, but they are breathing. We need to move them before the second wave locks down the entire sector. ' Overhead, the blue coolant pipes hiss under immense pressure, and a loud, rhythmic alarm begins to echo from the deeper sub-levels of the C-17 district.
choices: Guide the civilians through the dark drainage pipes to avoid the searchlights. (Agility)
Smash the maintenance gate lock to clear a direct path to the surface streets. (Strength)

scenes.title: A Fracture in the Furnace
scenes.narration: The heavy iron maintenance gate blocks the only direct ascent to the surface, its mechanical lock whistling with warning pressure. Your muscles strain against the cold metal as you drive your weight into the rusted mechanism, shattering the internal gears with a violent, echoing crack. Jung Se-rin pulls the shivering civilians out of the holding cage, her eyes wide as she guides them past the broken gate. Above us, the city's red warning lights sweep the walls; Administrator IX's voice echoes from the overhead speakers, declaring a localized purge protocol. The pursuit is no longer a shadow on the wall—the Enforcers are descending the service shafts directly above us. (Strength: "Yeah! That's how you clear a path! Smash the iron, break their locks, and keep moving straight through. They can't stop muscle! ")

scenes.title: Ash-Smeared Streets
scenes.narration: The heavy iron maintenance gate screeches open, exposing a narrow alleyway where the rain falls like liquid lead. Red emergency searchlights from the overhead drones sweep the wet concrete, washing the crumbling walls in a rhythmic, bloody pulse. Jung Se-rin shoves the last shivering civilian into the shadow of a rusted shipping container, her face smeared with gray soot and sweat. Above you, the sky of Neo-Seoul is a dark vault of static, and the synthetic wail of tactical sirens confirms the control grid's pursuit has reached absolute saturation. We have no time to hide; the Enforcers are locking down the entire block, and the smell of ozone rises from the approaching heavy mechs.
choices: Slip into the overflowing storm drain to bypass the searchlights. (Agility)
Draw your weapon and draw the drones' attention away from the civilians.

scenes.narration: The smoking chassis of the patrol drone you just tore apart crackles with dying blue sparks on the wet asphalt, its optic lens shattered into a dozen dark mirrors. Jung Se-rin leans heavily against the wet concrete wall, her chest heaving as she wipes a streak of black oil and cold rain from her cheek. 'The network isn't just searching anymore,' she says, her voice hushed but sharp as the wind. 'That patrol was routed directly to our exact coordinates. They knew we were here before we even cleared the gate. ' The heavy smell of ozone and burnt wiring hangs thick in the narrow alleyway, a stark reminder that every victory in these streets only draws the eye of Administrator IX closer. The civilians we pulled from the incinerator are huddled behind the rusted container, their terrified whispers swallowed by the low hum of the city's power grid. We survived the ambush, but the red searchlights sweeping the upper girders mean our window of escape is rapidly closing. (Agility: Hear that high-pitched whine from the southern junction? ! It's a secondary sweep coming in fast—we need to move, now! ) (Intellect: The drone's memory core is still cycling through its shutdown sequence. Extracting the log now yields a 78% probability of tracing their routing protocols. )

scenes.title: A Breath of Ash and Lead
scenes.narration: The rain falls like liquid lead, washing the black oil from the shattered remains of the patrol drone into the cracked concrete. Your joints ache from the feedback of the suppression field, the physical toll of a narrow escape still vibrating in your bones. Jung Se-rin stands in the shadow of a rusted shipping container, her knuckles white as she grips her weapon, eyes darting to the sweeping red searchlights above. 'They've logged your signal signature,' she whispers, her voice cutting through the heavy hum of the low-altitude drones. 'If we stay in this alley, the next sweep will lock onto us before we can draw another breath. ' To the left, a dark storm drain offers a wet, lightless descent into the undergrid; to the right, a flickering neon sign marks the entrance to a maintenance corridor.

Force open the locked door of the maintenance corridor (Intellect)

scenes.title: Through the Broken Threshold
scenes.narration: The heavy steel door of the maintenance corridor screeches as the lock mechanism shears under your calculated pressure. You wedge your fingers into the gap, forcing the metal back until it yields with a sharp, echoing snap that reverberates through the wet concrete. Inside, the air is thick with the smell of scorched copper and old ozone, a stark contrast to the freezing downpour outside. Jung Se-rin slips in behind you, her wet boots squeaking against the metal grating as she immediately pulls the heavy door shut to block the sweeping red searchlights of the patrol above. 'They are locking down the entire sector,' she whispers, her eyes reflecting the dim amber emergency lights of the corridor. 'If we stay in this bottleneck, we are dead. ' The pursuit is right on your heels, and the walls hum with the vibration of approaching enforcer steps. You have found temporary cover, but the corridor splits into a steep ventilation shaft leading down and a pressurized security sub-station to the right.
choices: Slide down the steep ventilation shaft into the lower drainage system (Agility)
Bypass the security sub-station terminal to lock the outer doors behind you (Intellect)

scenes.title: The Ash-Stained Corridor
scenes.narration:
The heavy steel door slams shut behind you, cutting off the freezing downpour of C-17 and locking out the wailing drone sirens. Inside the narrow maintenance corridor, the air is thick with the smell of scorched copper and old ozone. Jung Se-rin leans against the damp concrete wall, her breath coming in shallow, ragged gasps as she watches you work on the terminal. The emergency red lights of the sub-station flicker across her face, highlighting the dark soot smeared across her temple.

Your fingers move rapidly over the auxiliary console, bypassing the security sub-station terminal to lock the outer doors. The terminal screen flickers with a series of harsh warnings before the magnetic locks hiss into a permanent seal, isolating you from the hunting patrol. (Intellect: The bypass is 94. 2% stable. The physical lock will hold for exactly six minutes before the backup grid initiates an automatic override. )

scenes.title: The Last Safe House
scenes.narration: Blue sparks shower the concrete floor as you tear open the junction box, your fingers flying across the exposed, high-voltage copper terminals. The control grid's pursuit lines are screaming through the overhead speakers, a cold, synthesized warning from Administrator IX demanding immediate correction. Jung Se-rin pulls the shivering civilian target you rescued from the incinerator deeper into the maintenance alcove, her hand pressed firmly over the child's mouth to keep them silent. With one final, calculated terminal bypass, you redirect the main transit line's power grid, plunging the entire subway junction into a heavy, dead silence. The heavy hydraulic rams at the security doors cease their thudding as the power dies, leaving only the sound of your own ragged breathing in the absolute dark.
choices: Lead the survivors through the unpowered maintenance tunnels (Agility)
Access the dead terminal's emergency channel to speak to Administrator IX (Intellect)
